subject: Retention exception runbook — subprocessor onboarding & backup purge timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Acme Health Legal Ops <legal-ops@acmehealth.com>, Sara Miller <sara.miller@medboxhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Retention exception runbook — subprocessor onboarding & backup purge timeline

Hi Sara / Acme legal team,

Thanks for the call earlier — following up with the first-pass runbook and a proposed timeline for the limited retention carve-out we discussed. Attached: redwood_retention_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook + controls checklist).

High-level ask: Acme has requested a temporary retention exemption for ephemeral debug logs and certain daily VM snapshots that are needed to restore sessions during the migration period for your pilot. We propose:
- Scope: debug-level application logs (non-PHI), ephemeral VM snapshots used for hot-restore during pilot only.
- Retention window: 90 days from capture for the scoped items. All production backups and audit logs remain at standard retention.
- Backup purge timeline: snapshots created before 2027-06-30 will be purged by 2027-07-15.
- Subprocessor onboarding: Redwood will add the new storage subprocessor (CloudStore Europe) to the DPA appendix and provide evidence of SCCs / Transfer Impact Assessment by 2027-06-07.
- Proof of deletion: we will provide a deletion manifest and cryptographic hash summary within 5 days of purge job completion.

Requested confirmations from Acme legal:
1) Is a 90-day scoped exception acceptable for the pilot artifacts (we can tighten to 60 days if needed)?
2) Will Acme accept the proposed proof-of-deletion format (attached template) and signed confirmation from our subprocessor?
3) Any additional checklist items your security team requires (SOC2/reporting, on-demand access to audit logs, key separation)?

Next steps: if you confirm scope and timeframe, we'll prepare an amendment to the DPA and a DocuSign for signature; onboarding of the storage subprocessor will begin immediately after sign-off.

Thanks — looping in Laura (engineering) and Priyom (privacy ops) to track the runbook changes.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_retention_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: Acme Health Legal Ops <legal-ops@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Miller <sara.miller@medboxhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 11:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention exception runbook — subprocessor onboarding & backup purge timeline

Ben —

Thanks for the clear summary and the draft runbook. A couple of clarifying requests from legal / data protection:

1) Justification: we need a short, documented business justification for the 90-day window tied to the pilot activities (restore windows, debug cycles). Please add one paragraph to the runbook.
2) Data types: confirm explicitly that no PHI or regulated health identifiers are included in the scoped artifacts.
3) Access controls: provide details on MFA for subprocessor console access, breakdown of which roles can request restores, and whether the subprocessor has standing read access.
4) Cross-border transfers: Acme requires that CloudStore Europe operate under SCCs and provide a Transfer Impact Assessment; please attach the SCCs and any TIA artifacts.
5) Evidence: we need SOC2 Type II (or equivalent) for CloudStore Europe and a scan of the DPA appendix showing the new subprocessor entry.

Can you send an updated runbook with these items and the filled acme_subproc_request_form.docx by EOD Monday (2027-05-31)? I have attached a simple form for the onboarding.

Also please cc: Data Protection Officer (dpo@acmehealth.com) on the updated package.

— Acme Legal Ops
Attachment: acme_subproc_request_form.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Acme Health Legal Ops <legal-ops@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention exception runbook — subprocessor onboarding & backup purge timeline

Hi — quick technical notes to address the questions from legal. Im pasting the bits to include in the updated runbook: 

- Business justification (one-liner): The scoped 90-day retention window is limited to pilot debug artifacts and VM snapshots required to support hot-restores and triage during the migration pilot between Acme and Redwood-managed environments. The window reduces data exposure while enabling practical rollback/testing.

- Data types: Confirmed: debug-level logs do not contain PHI or protected health identifiers. Application-level traces are redacted by the ingestion layer; we will include a snippet in the runbook showing the redaction pipeline.

- Access controls: CloudStore Europe will have no standing read privileges to application traffic. Restore jobs are initiated through Redwoods control plane and require two-person approval (engineer + Acme ops approver) for any snapshot restore. Subprocessor console access is restricted and MFA enforced via SAML; we will include the access matrix in the runbook.

- Cross-border transfers: CloudStore Europe endpoints will be bound by SCCs. Redwood will run a standard TIA for the subprocessor and include the results in the DPA appendix. We will also provide SOC2 Type II report for CloudStore Europe (or equivalent cert).

- Deletion proof: we will run lifecycle purge jobs and produce a deletion_manifest_template.csv (attached). The subprocessor will sign the manifest and we will provide an S3/GCS job id and cryptographic digest.

Action items for Redwood: 
1) Ben: draft amendment + DocuSign packet for Acme legal (target 2027-06-02).
2) Priyom: complete TIA and obtain SOC2 evidence from CloudStore (target 2027-06-07).
3) Engineering (me): implement the deletion manifest hook and schedule purge by 2027-07-15.

Priyom, I'll hand off the manifest template and the deletion job playbook off-line. Ben, once legal confirms the 90-day window well update the DPA appendix and send to Acme.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
Attachment: deletion_manifest_template.csv
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Acme Health Legal Ops <legal-ops@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 May 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention exception runbook — subprocessor onboarding & backup purge timeline

Acme legal / Sara —

Acknowledged. We will:
- Populate the acme_subproc_request_form.docx and return by 2027-05-31 EOD.
- Complete the Transfer Impact Assessment and attach SCCs by 2027-06-07.
- Obtain SOC2 evidence and provide a certified copy or redacted report by 2027-06-07.
- Prepare the DPA amendment and DocuSign by 2027-06-02 (Ben will send the packet).

I have opened INF-4821 to track the onboarding and deletion manifest delivery. Once the DocuSign is completed we will kick off the onboarding workflow and schedule a purge job; a post-purge signed manifest and job ids will be shared within 5 business days after 2027-07-15.

If anything else is required, please reply here or add items to INF-4821.

Best,
Priyom Das
Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
